title: FFA Forms & Resources
before:
The following forms, publications, and resources are related to opportunities with the Maine FFA Association. To see recent Maine recipients of some of these honors, visit the Award Winners web page.

Awards
  • National FFA Chapter Award — Recognizes outstanding chapters at the state and national levels.
  • Proficiency Awards — Recognize out-of-class-related accomplishments of Maine FFA members.
  • Star Awards — Recognition of superior accomplishment by FFA members in out-of-class activities. Applicants must also have completed a State FFA Degree application.
  • Chapter FFA Advisor of the Year — Nominate Today — Recognize the outstanding performance of a chapter advisor.
  • Outstanding Chapter Officer — Recognition based on nomination by chapter FFA advisor of a chapter officer with exceptional qualities and accomplishments.
Scholarships
  • Ronald P. Guerrette — March 15
  • Maine Potato Board — March 27
  • Old York Garden Club — April 1
  • Maine Blue Collar Scholarship — April 15
  • Maine Association of Ag. Fairs — April 15
  • Maine Grange — April 20
  • Russell Libby Award — April 30
  • Maine Nutrition Council — May 30
  • FAME Agricultural Scholarships — Additional agriculture-related scholarships through the Finance Authority of Maine.
Degrees, Conferences & Opportunities
  • State FFA Degree
  • American FFA Degree — Highest level of degree bestowed at the national level.
  • Base Camp Conference — Annual initial training event for new State FFA Officers and selected Chapter FFA Officers.
  • Washington Leadership Conference — One-week summer training in Washington, D.C. A limited number of scholarships (not including travel) are available.
  • State FFA Officer Applications:
    • State Officer Application
    • Class Presentations Overview & Expectations
    • Class Presentations Request
    • Officer Exam — Practice Questions with Answers

FFA Conventions

National FFA Convention — Annual event attended by over 70,000 FFA members. See the National FFA website for questions from past years' competitions.

State Convention — The 2027 Maine State Convention will be held at the University of Maine Presque Isle.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 3 links on this page open a file — 1 Word, 1 PDF, 1 Excel — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 7 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 7 list items open with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Give an unlinked item the same title weight
decisions.why: 1 item sits in a list of links and descriptions without being a link, so it comes out as the only row with no title — which reads as a fault in the list. The title takes the same weight as its neighbours. No link is invented, because there is no address to invent.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: The following forms, publications, and resources are related to opportunities with the Maine FFA Association. To see recent Maine recipients of some of these honors, visit the Award Winners web page.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 1 table runs to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box and a "show 25 entries" menu above the table, makes the column headings sortable, and pages below twenty-five rows at a time — which leaves all but the longest tables whole. Nothing is reordered and nothing changes until someone types.
